name: Bluegrass Jam Readiness Diagnostic — Guitar
creator: Kirk Kenney
description: A diagnostic for gathering information relevant to whether a guitarist is ready to participate in a bluegrass jam.
use_when: A guitarist wants to know whether they are ready to attend a bluegrass jam
A guitarist wants to identify areas to work on before jamming

basic_mechanics.question: Do you know any music theory at all?
Can you strum with regular time?

applied_musicianship.question: Have you tried jamming with anyone yet?
Can you play along successfully with a song recording?
Can you sing and strum at the same time?

limitations: Version 0.1 gathers diagnostic information but does not yet contain rules for making a final jam-readiness determination.
The diagnostic currently applies specifically to guitar.
